objectives.title: Single Payload
objectives.description: At regular intervals, a Payload spawns at the center of the battleground that can be contested by both teams.

objectives.title: Escort Payload
objectives.description: Stand next to the Payload and move it to its destination. Prevent the enemy from trying to do the same.

objectives.title: Bombard your Enemy
objectives.description: Once a team escorts the Payload to its destination, it will fire upon the enemy's Structures!
